image_prompts: Two empty chairs side by side in a sunny school library
A shared lunchbox with two sandwiches and a note on a wooden table
words.image_desc_en: Two empty chairs placed next to each other in a bright library with bookshelves in the background.
words.image_desc_cn: 明亮的图书馆里，两把空椅子并排放置，背景是书架。
words.usage: 动词短语，常与 with 连用，表示与某人建立友谊。
words.collocations: make friends with, try to make friends, easy to make friends

examples.en: It is easy to make friends in a new class.
examples.cn: 在新班级里交朋友很容易。

examples.en: She wants to make friends with her new neighbor.
examples.cn: 她想和新邻居交朋友。

socratic_questions.question: If you move to a new school, what is the first step to make friends?
socratic_questions.answer_hint: Say hello and share something like a pencil or a snack.

socratic_questions.question: Why do people often say 'smile' helps to make friends?
socratic_questions.answer_hint: A smile makes you look friendly and easy to talk to.

sentences: It is important to ___ with classmates in a new school.
She tries to ___ with her desk mate by sharing snacks.
A friendly smile can help you ___ more easily.

image_prompts: A new library with open books and a welcome sign
A map of a city with pins marking places to explore
words.image_desc_en: A bright library with shelves of books and a sign that says 'Welcome' on the desk.
words.image_desc_cn: 一个明亮的图书馆，书架上摆满了书，桌上有一块写着“欢迎”的牌子。
words.usage: 表示通过时间或接触慢慢熟悉某人或某物，强调过程而非瞬间动作。

examples.en: I want to get to know this new school better.
examples.cn: 我想更好地了解这所新学校。

examples.en: We can get to know the park by walking around.
examples.cn: 我们可以通过四处走走了解这个公园。

socratic_questions.question: If you move to a new town, what can you do to get to know it?
socratic_questions.answer_hint: You can visit the library, walk in the park, or look at a map.

socratic_questions.question: Why is it important to get to know the rules of a new place?
socratic_questions.answer_hint: Because rules help you know what is right and safe to do.

sentences: I want to ___ the new library near my home.
It takes time to ___ a new city.
We can ___ each other by talking after class.

image_prompts: A glass of water filled to the brim
A lunchbox packed with sandwiches and fruit
words.image_desc_en: A clear glass completely filled with water, with no space left at the top.
words.image_desc_cn: 一个透明玻璃杯装满了水，水面几乎与杯口齐平。
words.usage: 形容词，常与 be 动词连用，表示某物被完全填满或某状态达到极限。
words.collocations: be full of, full up, full moon

examples.en: The bottle is full of orange juice.
examples.cn: 瓶子里装满了橙汁。

examples.en: My schoolbag is full of books today.
examples.cn: 今天我的书包里装满了书。

socratic_questions.question: If a cup is full, can you add more water?
socratic_questions.answer_hint: No, because there is no space left.

sentences: The box is ___ of toys.
The box is ___ of toys.

image_prompts: A passport with a person's full name printed on the cover
A school ID card showing the full name in capital letters
words.image_desc_en: A close-up of a passport and an ID card, both displaying a complete full name in clear black text.
words.image_desc_cn: 一本护照和一张学生证的近景，上面都用清晰的黑色字体显示了完整的全名。
words.usage: 用于正式场合或表格中，表示一个人的完整姓名，通常包括名（given name）和姓（family name）。

examples.en: Please write your full name on the top line.
examples.cn: 请在第一行写上你的全名。

examples.en: My full name is on the cover of this book.
examples.cn: 我的全名写在这本书的封面上。

socratic_questions.question: Why do we need to write our full name on a passport instead of just a first name?
socratic_questions.answer_hint: Because a full name helps identify a person exactly and avoids confusion with others who share the same first name.

sentences: Please write your ___ on the form before you hand it in.
The teacher asked everyone to say their ___ at the beginning of class.
You need to put your ___ on the test paper.

image_prompts: A report card with an A+ grade on a desk
A stack of graded papers with red marks on a table
words.image_desc_en: A close-up of a report card showing a high grade with a red pen next to it on a wooden desk.
words.image_desc_cn: 一张成绩单的特写，显示高分，旁边有一支红笔放在木桌上。
words.usage: grade 可指学校的年级，也可指作业或考试的分数等级。

examples.en: She got a good grade on the math test.
examples.cn: 她在数学考试中取得了好成绩。

examples.en: My brother is in the seventh grade this year.
examples.cn: 我哥哥今年上七年级。

socratic_questions.question: Why do teachers give grades on homework?
socratic_questions.answer_hint: To show how well a student understands the lesson.

sentences: My sister is in the eighth ___ this year.
The teacher gave a high ___ for my project.

image_prompts: A library card with the surname printed at the bottom
A passport page showing the family name field
words.image_desc_en: A close-up of a library card with the word 'Smith' written under 'Last Name'.
words.image_desc_cn: 一张借书卡的特写，在“姓氏”一栏下写着“Smith”。
words.usage: 用于指代一个人的家族姓氏，常与 first name（名字）相对。

examples.en: Please write your last name on the top line.
examples.cn: 请在第一行写上你的姓氏。

examples.en: My last name is Wang, and my first name is Lei.
examples.cn: 我姓王，名字叫雷。

socratic_questions.question: Why do we put last name after first name in some forms?
socratic_questions.answer_hint: In English, the family name often comes last, but in some cultures it comes first.

sentences: On the form, you need to fill in your ___ first.
A. first name B. last name C. middle name D. full name

image_prompts: Two desks side by side with a shared pencil case in the middle
A row of backpacks hanging on hooks in a classroom
words.image_desc_en: Two wooden desks placed next to each other, with a blue pencil case and a notebook lying between them, under a window with sunlight.
words.image_desc_cn: 两张并排的木桌，中间放着一个蓝色铅笔盒和一本笔记本，窗户透进阳光。
words.usage: 指在同一班级学习的人，常用于描述学校中一起上课的伙伴。

examples.en: My classmate and I share a desk in the classroom.
examples.cn: 我和我的同班同学在教室里共用一张课桌。

examples.en: The new classmate sits next to the window.
examples.cn: 新来的同班同学坐在窗户旁边。

socratic_questions.question: Why do you think a classmate is different from a friend?
socratic_questions.answer_hint: A classmate is someone in the same class, but a friend can be from any class or place.

sentences: My ___ and I do homework together after school.
The teacher asks a ___ to help clean the board.
I meet my ___ at the school gate every morning.

image_prompts: A classroom with a desk and a stack of notebooks
A whiteboard with lesson notes and a pointer
words.image_desc_en: A classroom desk with a stack of notebooks and a red pen, next to a whiteboard with lesson notes and a pointer.
words.image_desc_cn: 一张教室课桌上放着一叠笔记本和一支红笔，旁边是一块写有课程笔记的白板和一根教鞭。
words.usage: class teacher 指负责管理一个班级的教师，常用于学校语境。
preposition_combos: ask the class teacher for help

examples.en: Our class teacher checks homework every morning.
examples.cn: 我们的班主任每天早上检查作业。

examples.en: The class teacher will hold a meeting next Monday.
examples.cn: 班主任下周一将开一个会议。

socratic_questions.question: Why does a class teacher need to check homework?
socratic_questions.answer_hint: To see if students understand the lesson and help them improve.

sentences: Our ___ checks our homework every day.
The ___ will talk to us about the school trip.

image_prompts: A wooden nameplate with 'Tom' carved on it, hanging on a classroom door
A red pencil case with the name 'Tom' written in black marker on the side
words.image_desc_en: A wooden nameplate with the name Tom carved on it, attached to a classroom door.
words.image_desc_cn: 一块刻有名字Tom的木制名牌，挂在教室门上。
words.usage: Tom 是英语中常见的男性名字，常用于日常对话和课本中作为人物称呼。

examples.en: Tom has a new blue schoolbag on his desk.
examples.cn: 汤姆的书桌上有一个新的蓝色书包。

examples.en: Please give this pencil case to Tom after class.
examples.cn: 下课后请把这个铅笔盒给汤姆。

socratic_questions.question: If you see 'Tom' written on a notebook, what does it tell you?
socratic_questions.answer_hint: It tells you the notebook belongs to someone named Tom.

socratic_questions.question: Why do we use a capital letter for the first letter of 'Tom'?
socratic_questions.answer_hint: Because it is a name, and names always start with a capital letter in English.

sentences: ___ is my new classmate from London.
This blue ruler belongs to ___.
___ and I often play football after school.

image_prompts: A steaming metal pot on a table with raw vegetables and meat slices around it
A bubbling red broth in a ceramic pot with chopsticks and a ladle nearby
words.image_desc_en: A metal pot filled with boiling soup and ingredients sits on a table, with plates of raw food and dipping sauces around it.
words.image_desc_cn: 一个装满沸腾汤底和食材的金属锅放在桌上，周围摆着生食盘和蘸料。
words.usage: 名词，指一种将食材放入沸腾汤底中煮熟食用的中式烹饪方式。
words.collocations: have hot pot, eat hot pot, hot pot restaurant, hot pot soup base
words.preposition_combos: hot pot with friends, hot pot at home, ingredients for hot pot

examples.en: We often have hot pot at home in winter.
examples.cn: 冬天我们经常在家吃火锅。

examples.en: The hot pot soup base is very spicy today.
examples.cn: 今天的火锅汤底非常辣。

socratic_questions.question: Why do people usually eat hot pot in cold weather?
socratic_questions.answer_hint: Because the hot soup keeps the body warm and the meal is shared.

socratic_questions.question: What ingredients can you put into a hot pot?
socratic_questions.answer_hint: Meat, vegetables, tofu, mushrooms, and noodles.

sentences: My family likes to have ___ together on weekends.

image_prompts: A desk with a name tag reading Sally on it
A notebook with the name Sally written on the cover
words.image_desc_en: A wooden desk with a small name tag that says Sally, next to a pencil and an eraser.
words.image_desc_cn: 一张木桌上放着一个写着Sally的小名牌，旁边有一支铅笔和一块橡皮。
words.usage: Sally 是英语中常见的女性名字，用于称呼或指代某位女性。

examples.en: Sally has a new red pencil case.
examples.cn: 萨莉有一个新的红色铅笔盒。

examples.en: Is this Sally's blue schoolbag?
examples.cn: 这是萨莉的蓝色书包吗？

socratic_questions.question: If you see a name tag that says Sally, what can you guess about the owner?
socratic_questions.answer_hint: The owner is probably a girl named Sally, and the tag might be on her desk or locker.

sentences: This is ___ schoolbag.
___ is my friend.
I have a pen from ___.

image_prompts: A stack of wooden logs in a forest clearing
A wooden table with a smooth surface and visible grain
words.image_desc_en: A pile of cut logs with bark and tree rings, lying on the ground near a forest path.
words.image_desc_cn: 一堆砍下的原木，带有树皮和年轮，放在森林小径旁的地面上。
words.usage: Wood 是不可数名词，指作为材料的木头或木材；也可指一片树林（woods）。

examples.en: This table is made of strong wood.
examples.cn: 这张桌子是用结实的木头做的。

examples.en: We need more wood for the fire.
examples.cn: 我们需要更多木头来生火。

socratic_questions.question: Why is wood often used to make furniture?
socratic_questions.answer_hint: Because wood is strong, easy to shape, and comes from trees.

socratic_questions.question: What happens to wood when it gets wet for a long time?
socratic_questions.answer_hint: It can rot or become soft and weak.

sentences: The chair is made of ___.
We collected dry ___ for the campfire.
A forest has many tall trees and lots of ___.

image_prompts: A view of Sydney Opera House beside the harbor at sunset
A map showing Sydney's location on the east coast of Australia
words.image_desc_en: A famous harbor city in Australia with a white shell-shaped opera house and a large bridge.
words.image_desc_cn: 澳大利亚著名的海港城市，拥有白色贝壳形歌剧院和一座大桥。
words.usage: Sydney 是专有名词，通常指澳大利亚最大的城市，常用于谈论旅行、地理位置或文化地标。

examples.en: My family plans to visit Sydney next summer.
examples.cn: 我家计划明年夏天去悉尼旅游。

examples.en: The Sydney Opera House is a famous building.
examples.cn: 悉尼歌剧院是一座著名的建筑。

socratic_questions.question: Why is Sydney a popular city for tourists?
socratic_questions.answer_hint: Because it has famous landmarks like the Opera House and the Harbour Bridge, and beautiful beaches.

sentences: The capital of Australia is Canberra, but ___ is the largest city.
Many tourists take photos of the ___ Opera House.
The flight from Beijing to ___ takes about 11 hours.

image_prompts: A map of Australia with the Great Barrier Reef visible
A kangaroo standing next to a red desert rock formation
A Sydney Opera House silhouette against a sunset sky
words.image_desc_en: A red kangaroo stands beside a large red rock in a desert landscape under a blue sky.
words.image_desc_cn: 一只红色袋鼠站在沙漠景观中的一块大红岩石旁，天空湛蓝。
words.usage: 名词，指大洋洲的一个国家，首都为堪培拉。

examples.en: My pen pal lives in Australia near the beach.
examples.cn: 我的笔友住在澳大利亚的海滩附近。

examples.en: Kangaroos and koalas come from Australia.
examples.cn: 袋鼠和考拉来自澳大利亚。

socratic_questions.question: Why do many animals in Australia look different from animals in other countries?
socratic_questions.answer_hint: Because Australia is an island continent and its animals evolved separately for millions of years.

sentences: Kangaroos are native to ___.
The Great Barrier Reef is located off the coast of ___.
Sydney is a famous city in ___.

image_prompts: A white ceramic bowl filled with steaming Mapo tofu, red chili oil floating on top, green scallion slices scattered, on a wooden table
A close-up of a spoon scooping soft tofu cubes in spicy red sauce, with Sichuan peppercorns visible on the surface
words.image_desc_en: A bowl of Mapo tofu with red chili oil and green scallions on a wooden table.
words.image_desc_cn: 一碗麻婆豆腐，表面浮着红辣椒油和绿色葱花，放在木桌上。
words.meaning_cn: 麻婆豆腐（一道四川传统辣味豆腐菜肴）
words.usage: Mapo tofu 通常作为不可数名词使用，指一道菜。

examples.en: My mother cooks delicious Mapo tofu for dinner.
examples.cn: 我妈妈晚餐做了美味的麻婆豆腐。

examples.en: We often order Mapo tofu at the Sichuan restaurant.
examples.cn: 我们经常在四川餐馆点麻婆豆腐。

socratic_questions.question: Why do people put chili oil in Mapo tofu?
socratic_questions.answer_hint: To make it spicy and give it a red color.

socratic_questions.question: What main ingredient is in Mapo tofu besides tofu?
socratic_questions.answer_hint: Minced pork or beef, and Sichuan peppercorns.

sentences: I want to eat a bowl of ___ for lunch.
The restaurant serves very spicy ___.
Can you teach me how to cook ___?

image_prompts: A whole duck hanging in a restaurant kitchen with golden crispy skin
A plate of sliced duck meat with thin pancakes and spring onions on a wooden table
words.image_desc_en: A close-up of a whole roasted duck with shiny brown skin, hanging on a metal rack in a warm kitchen.
words.image_desc_cn: 一只表皮油亮棕红的整只烤鸭挂在厨房金属架上。
words.usage: Beijing roast is a famous dish from Beijing, China. It is often served with pancakes, sauce, and vegetables.

examples.en: We ordered Beijing roast for dinner last night.
examples.cn: 昨晚我们点了北京烤鸭当晚餐。

examples.en: Beijing roast tastes best with sweet bean sauce.
examples.cn: 北京烤鸭配上甜面酱味道最好。

socratic_questions.question: Why do people eat Beijing roast with thin pancakes?
socratic_questions.answer_hint: Because the pancakes help wrap the duck, sauce, and vegetables together for a balanced taste.

sentences: My family likes to eat ___ on weekends.
___ is a traditional dish from China.
We need to order a whole ___ for the party.

image_prompts: A modern skyline with a giant ferris wheel and a futuristic hotel with a ship on top
A clean street lined with tall palm trees and colorful colonial buildings
words.image_desc_en: A view of Singapore's skyline showing the Marina Bay Sands hotel and the Singapore Flyer against a blue sky.
words.image_desc_cn: 新加坡天际线的景色，展示了滨海湾金沙酒店和新加坡摩天观景轮，背景是蓝天。
words.usage: Singapore 用作专有名词，指代国家或城市，常与 in, from, to 等介词连用。

examples.en: My pen pal comes from Singapore.
examples.cn: 我的笔友来自新加坡。

examples.en: Singapore is a clean and green city.
examples.cn: 新加坡是一个干净又绿色的城市。

socratic_questions.question: If you want to visit a warm country in Southeast Asia, why might you choose Singapore?
socratic_questions.answer_hint: Because Singapore has a modern city, good food, and a warm climate all year.

sentences: My aunt lives in ___.
The plane from Beijing to ___ takes about six hours.

image_prompts: A long stone wall winding over green mountains under a blue sky
A watchtower on a stone wall with autumn leaves around it
words.image_desc_en: A long stone wall stretches across green hills under a clear blue sky, with a watchtower visible in the distance.
words.image_desc_cn: 一道长长的石墙在蓝天下的青山上蜿蜒伸展，远处可见一座烽火台。
words.usage: 专有名词，通常与定冠词 the 连用，首字母大写。
words.collocations: visit the Great Wall, walk on the Great Wall, see the Great Wall
words.preposition_combos: on the Great Wall, at the Great Wall, along the Great Wall

examples.en: We plan to visit the Great Wall next Sunday.
examples.cn: 我们计划下周日去参观长城。

examples.en: Many tourists take photos on the Great Wall.
examples.cn: 许多游客在长城上拍照。

socratic_questions.question: Why do we say 'the Great Wall' instead of just 'Great Wall'?
socratic_questions.answer_hint: Because it is a unique landmark, so we use 'the' before its name.

sentences: My family wants to visit ___ next summer.
___ is one of the most famous places in China.
We took many pictures on ___.

image_prompts: A name tag on a desk in a classroom
A notebook with the name Pauline written on the cover
words.image_desc_en: A wooden desk with a white name tag that reads 'Pauline' in black letters.
words.image_desc_cn: 一张木桌上放着一个白色姓名牌，上面用黑色字母写着‘Pauline’。
words.usage: Pauline 是一个英文女性名字，常用于称呼或介绍某人。

examples.en: Pauline has a blue pencil case on her desk.
examples.cn: 波琳的桌子上有一个蓝色的铅笔盒。

examples.en: Is this ruler Pauline's or yours?
examples.cn: 这把尺子是波琳的还是你的？

socratic_questions.question: If you see a book with the name Pauline on it, what can you guess?

sentences: This is ___ schoolbag.

B. Pauline's
C. Paulines
D. Paulines'

image_prompts: A name tag on a desk in a classroom
A book cover with the name 'Lee' written on it
words.image_desc_en: A wooden desk with a small name tag that reads 'Lee' in black letters.
words.image_desc_cn: 一张木桌上放着一个写有黑色字母“Lee”的小名牌。
words.usage: Lee 是英语中常见的姓氏，用于称呼某人或指代姓李的人。
words.preposition_combos: of Lee (e.g., the book of Lee)

examples.en: Mr. Lee is our English teacher.
examples.cn: 李先生是我们的英语老师。

examples.en: This pencil case belongs to Lee.
examples.cn: 这个铅笔盒是李的。

socratic_questions.question: If you see 'Lee' on a door, what might be inside?
socratic_questions.answer_hint: An office or classroom of someone named Lee.

sentences: ___ is a common family name in English.
My friend ___ sits next to me.

image_prompts: A brown dog collar with a name tag that says Coco on a wooden table
A pet food bowl with the name Coco painted on the side next to a leash

words.usage: Coco 常用作宠物（尤其是狗或猫）的昵称，在对话中指代特定的宠物。

examples.en: Coco likes to sleep on the sofa every afternoon.

examples.en: Please give some water to Coco after the walk.

socratic_questions.question: If Coco is a pet name, what kind of animal do you think Coco might be?

socratic_questions.question: Why do people give their pets names like Coco instead of just calling them 'dog' or 'cat'?
socratic_questions.answer_hint: Because a name makes the pet feel like a family member and helps us call them easily.

sentences: ___ is the name of my pet dog.

___ likes to play with a red ball.

image_prompts: A red double-decker bus on a rainy street
A view of the River Thames with Big Ben in the background

words.usage: 专有名词，指英国的首都城市。

examples.en: My pen friend lives in London, England.
examples.cn: 我的笔友住在英国伦敦。

examples.en: The train from London arrives at noon.
examples.cn: 从伦敦来的火车中午到达。

socratic_questions.question: Why is London a famous city in the world?
socratic_questions.answer_hint: Because it has many famous places like Big Ben and the River Thames.

sentences: The capital of the UK is ___.

A passport page showing the first name field filled in
An ID card with the first name highlighted in a box

words.preposition_combos: with a first name, under first name

examples.en: Please write your first name on the top line.

examples.en: My first name is Tom, and my last name is Green.
